'''V5-T transport droids''' were manufactured by [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]]. They were [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]], with no more intelligence than required to obey simple commands. Unfortunately, they were not intelligent enough to recognize from ''whom'' they should take orders, and would take orders from anyone unless programmed to respond only from individuals with specific [[Identichip/Legends|identification cards]], such as used by [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] employees. They could be preprogrammed to take faster routes, and advanced versions had a remote [[Computer/Legends|computer]] link through which they could learn traffic conditions or receive orders via com signal. Each droid was 2.2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, essentially a box (capable of carrying up to two metric tons) with retractable lifting arms (capable of lifting up to 500 kilograms). A slower version with treaded wheels cost 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], while a faster [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-equipped version cost 4,500 credits.
